# `oaap app rename`

give an instance a different name (RFC-0026).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app rename [--grace-days GRACE_DAYS] [--yes]
                       [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                       name target
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `target` | the new name |
| `--grace-days GRACE_DAYS` | how long the old name keeps answering (default 30) |
| `--yes` | carry it out after reading the consequences |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
